Both of them like noodles and milk. Anna is reading a book about English. Anna thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. She checked her hair in the mirror.
Anna's favorite animal is the rabbit. Anna wrote about the day in the diary. Anna and Eva had great fun there. Also, she put a soft cushion on the chair.

Anna is going to travel to Xi'an in January. It takes twenty minutes to get to the post office by bike. The post office is one of the best places in the city.
